answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, tethering agent identity to capital rather than ephemeral compute. Like a glacier of locked assets, the collateral prevents attackers from flooding the network. If an adversary attempts to seize an island of influence, they face the knoll of validator slashing, losing their principal stake. This economic barrier makes generating infinite malicious identities prohibitively expensive, ensuring network integrity through verifiable financial risk.
